3.name: Assassinate
3.notes:
You excel at ambushing and eliminating targets.

Initiative. You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

Surprising Strikes. During the first round of each combat, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet. Additionally, if your Sneak Attack hits a target during that round, the target takes extra damage of the weapon’s type equal to your Rogue level.

3.name: Assassin's Tools
3.notes: You gain a Disguise Kit and a Poisoner’s Kit and proficiency with both.

9.name: Infiltration Expertise
9.notes:
Your mastery of infiltration grants the following benefits:

Masterful Mimicry. After studying a person’s speech or handwriting for at least 1 hour, you can mimic it unerringly.

Roving Aim. Your Speed is not reduced to 0 by using Steady Aim.

13.name: Envenom Weapons
13.notes: When you use the Poison option of your Cunning Strike, the target also takes 2d6 Poison damage whenever it fails the saving throw. This damage ignores Resistance to Poison.

17.name: Death Strike
17.notes: When you hit with your Sneak Attack during the first round of combat, the target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the attack’s total damage is doubled.
